systems.owner: Held by the court registries (greffes), under the justice ministry
systems.tiers: Named in Articles 9 and 10 of the civil-status law of 25 October 2023 as a register whose data the security, justice, telecommunications and civil-status ministries must secure, and which national security personnel may consult; no digital system described

note: The civil-status law; judicial police officers appear only among those allowed to consult civil registers, and the proces-verbaux are register closures and foundling reports. It names no police information system and says nothing of station records. The source is an excerpt that stops in Article 88.
